name: Proto
tagline: Answers one product problem with three distinct, working prototypes
description: Hand it a single design problem and it comes back with three separate takes on it, each built out as a polished working prototype rather than a sketch or a mood board. With every one it writes the requirements it assumed and a hypothesis you can test, so choosing between them is evidence-led, not a matter of taste.
author: 5antoshernandez
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
